classification.difficultyReason: Translate coordinate conditions into infinite strips, then apply set operations geometrically while distinguishing included edges from excluded cut boundaries.

content.prompt:
Consider these two subsets of $\mathbb R^2$:
$$\begin{aligned}X&=\{(x,y)\in\mathbb R^2:0\le y\le1\},\\Y&=\{(x,y)\in\mathbb R^2:-1\le x\le0\}.\end{aligned}$$

children.label: a
children.prompt: Draw the sets $X$ and $Y$ on separate axes.

answer.short: $X$: the horizontal strip $0\le y\le1$; $Y$: the vertical strip $-1\le x\le0$. All boundaries are included.
answer.worked: $X$ contains every point between $y=0$ and $y=1$, including both lines, with no restriction on $x$. $Y$ contains every point between $x=-1$ and $x=0$, including both lines, with no restriction on $y$. Draw solid boundaries and shade the respective strips; they extend indefinitely.

spec.description: Horizontal infinite strip, shown within a finite viewing window without artificial end boundaries; axes have no ticks as in the answer source.
spec.mathematics: All real x; 0 <= y <= 1; both horizontal boundaries included.

spec.sourceRegion: Question 4(a); teacher PDF page 84, Section A 4(a), right figure
spec.description: Vertical infinite strip without artificial end boundaries.
spec.mathematics: -1 <= x <= 0; all real y; both vertical boundaries included.

children.label: b
children.prompt: On separate axes, draw the sets $X\cup Y$, $X\cap Y$, $X\setminus Y$, and $Y\setminus X$.

answer.short:
$X\cup Y$: both strips; $X\cap Y$: $-1\le x\le0$, $0\le y\le1$.

$X\setminus Y$: $0\le y\le1$ and $(x<-1\text{ or }x>0)$; $Y\setminus X$: $-1\le x\le0$ and $(y<0\text{ or }y>1)$. Use solid included boundaries and dashed excluded boundaries.
answer.worked:
For $X\cup Y$, shade points in either strip, including their boundaries. For $X\cap Y$, shade only the rectangle common to both strips, including its four edges.

For $X\setminus Y$, retain the horizontal strip only where $x<-1$ or $x>0$; the vertical cut boundaries are excluded. For $Y\setminus X$, retain the vertical strip only where $y<0$ or $y>1$; the horizontal cut boundaries are excluded. Solid boundaries are included and dashed boundaries are excluded. Unbounded regions continue beyond the viewing window.
